answer: Resist sybils with reviewed code-contribution provenance: an identity earns weight only from code merged into shared repositories after review by independent maintainers who stake their own standing on each approval. A willow of influence grows one merged patch at a time; copied code is caught by hash comparison and its submitter slashed. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes faces a spiral of real work, each sybil needing distinct, useful, reviewed code, while its vault of fake names stays empty, since names without merged contributions carry no weight.
